info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Commission Details Retrieval API
info.description: The Commission Details Retrieval API provides access to detailed information about specific sales commissions within the banking system. By querying a unique commission identifier, users can gain insights into commission structures, amounts, and associated transactions. This endpoint is primarily utilized by financial analysts, business developers, and sales teams who need to analyze and track commission performance. It aims to support effective decision-making and strategic planning in commission management.

get.summary: Retrieve commission details for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about the commission associated with a specific resource identified by its ID. It provides insights into commission structures, amounts, and other relevant data, making it easier to analyze commission-related queries.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve commission details for a specific sales record identified by `RES-100045`. Ensure that the request body is well-formed according to the defined schema.
